items.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Released with Improved Cybersecurity, Validating 500+ high-severity Vulnerabilities
items.description: Anthropic’s latest AI model autonomously identifies critical flaws in decades-old codebases, raising the stakes for both defenders and attackers Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.6 on February 5, 2026, with dramatically enhanced cybersecurity capabilities that have already identified more than 500 previously unknown high-severity vulnerabilities in open-source software.
